title: Rosalind and the Will
author: Xanthe Blackwood
blurb: Sable Fairweather, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
